title: Declaring intent without the event id is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Sandbox stage {{tradeId}} is live and the vendor is invited.
steps: 1. POST /user_intents with the working body minus item_uuid.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' from Api::UserIntentsController#create app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb:14-15 (item_id blank); no user_intents row.
rationale: item_id links the answer to the event; item_id is NOT NULL, so without the guard this would be a DB error instead of a typed refusal.

title: Declaring intent without item_type is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live sandbox stage.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' from app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb:14-15.
rationale: item_type drives the polymorphic association; blank must never reach the model.

title: Declining to participate without any reason is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live sandbox stage.
steps: 1. POST /user_intents with intent_type trade_reject and neither reason nor remarks.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' from app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb:11-12 — a non-accept intent must carry reason or remarks.
rationale: Regret reasons feed the buyer's participation report; a reasonless decline loses the signal the feature exists for.

title: An intent with no intent_type is treated as a decline and still needs a reason
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live sandbox stage.
steps: 1. POST /user_intents with intent_type, reason and remarks all removed.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' from app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb:11 (nil is not 'trade_accept'); the default :trade_reject at :19 is never reached.
rationale: Pins the default: an omitted intent_type is a decline, never a silent accept.

title: An unknown intent_type does not crash the server
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live sandbox stage.
steps: 1. POST /user_intents with intent_type 'maybe' and a reason.
expectedResult: Should be a typed 422. intent_type is a Rails enum (app/models/user_intent.rb:33); assigning 'maybe' at app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb:19 raises ArgumentError and nothing rescues it — an untyped 500 is the suspected defect.
rationale: Rails enums raise on unknown values and the controller assigns the raw param.

title: An intent against a made-up item_type does not crash
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live sandbox stage.
expectedResult: Should be 422. belongs_to :item, polymorphic: true (app/models/user_intent.rb:29) constantizes item_type during validation; an unknown class raises NameError — 500 suspected. app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb:18
rationale: The controller only checks presence of item_type; any string reaches constantize.

title: An intent can only be recorded against an event, not another record type
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{userUuid}} is any user in the workspace.
expectedResult: Should be refused — only TradeRequest/EventGroup are meaningful targets. app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb:18-23 has no allowlist of item types, so today a 200 is likely.
rationale: No allowlist on item_type; intents can be attached to arbitrary records.

title: An intent on a non-existent event is refused, not silently dropped
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). None.
expectedResult: Should be a typed 422. If save fails (belongs_to item required) app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb:23 has no else branch, so Rails answers 204 No Content — which every client reads as success.
rationale: `render_success_json if save` with no failure branch turns validation errors into a silent 204.

title: Accepting to participate needs no reason
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live sandbox stage, vendor invited.
steps: 1. POST /user_intents with intent_type 'trade_accept' and no reason/remarks.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 success — app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb:11 exempts trade_accept from the reason rule; saved at :23.
rationale: The one explicit exemption; a tightening refactor would break the one-click participate button.

title: Script, SQL-ish and unicode text in regret remarks is stored safely
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live sandbox stage.
steps: 1. POST /user_intents with remarks containing a script tag, a quote/semicolon SQL fragment, emoji, Devanagari and 5,000 characters.
expectedResult: 200 or typed 4xx, never 5xx. ParamsAuth#sanitize_input_params (app/controllers/concerns/params_auth.rb:18-20) strips HTML tags; remarks is an unbounded varchar (app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb:21).
rationale: Regret remarks are shown to the buyer in the participants table — a stored-XSS and length sink.

title: A numeric reason instead of a list does not crash
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live sandbox stage.
expectedResult: 200 or typed 4xx. reason is jsonb; display_intent calls to_s (app/models/user_intent.rb). app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb:20
rationale: Type confusion on a jsonb column the buyer's report later renders.

title: Declining after accepting leaves one effective answer
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). The vendor already POSTed a trade_accept intent on {{tradeId}}.
expectedResult: Expected one effective answer. app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb:18 always inserts a new active row and never deactivates the previous one, so both stay active; the buyer's table (latest) and the trade page (exists?) can disagree.
rationale: No supersede logic — two contradictory active intents are possible.

title: A vendor cannot record intent on an event they are not invited to
preconditions: Session: a vendor NOT on the audience of {{tradeId}}.
steps: 1. POST /user_intents for {{tradeId}} as the uninvited vendor.
expectedResult: Should be refused (101). app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb:4-23 performs no audience or ownership check before writing.
rationale: A write path with no authorization check beyond login.

title: Changing the participation answer after the event closed
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{tradeId}} has passed its bid_end_time.
expectedResult: No window check exists in app/controllers/api/user_intents_controller.rb; today 200. Recorded so product decides whether post-close answers may rewrite the participation report.
rationale: No is_running guard — participation history can be rewritten after the event is decided.

title: A vendor who never answered participate can still open a bid
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live RFQ stage {{tradeId}}, vendor invited, no user_intents row for this vendor, no technical stage.
expectedResult: Today 200 with bid_uuid: Api::V1::BidsController#create (app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:11-39) and is_allowed_to_create_bid (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:7-78) never read UserIntent. The UI gates on user_intent_answered; the API does not.
rationale: The user asked for 'bid without participating'. The only gate is client-side.

title: A vendor who declined to participate can still open a bid
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). The vendor recorded a trade_reject intent on {{tradeId}}; stage is live.
expectedResult: Should be refused. Nothing in app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:11-39 or app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:7-78 reads the trade_reject intent, so 200 is expected today; only the legacy surrogate path touches intents (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:521-528, marks them converted).
rationale: The buyer's report would show the vendor as both declined and bidding.

title: A vendor who declined can still submit a priced bid
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). trade_reject intent recorded; a priced draft bid {{bidUuid}} exists.
steps: 1. PATCH /v1/bids/{{bidUuid}} with the working submit body.
expectedResult: Should be refused. update (app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:41-66) → update_bid_helper (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:367-487) has no intent check; success:true expected today and the declined vendor ranks.
rationale: The version that changes ranks and savings: a declined vendor can end up L1.

title: Opening a non-existent event does not crash
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). None.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 4 'Request not found'. Api::TradeController#show replaces a nil trade with `TradeRequest.joins(:bids)...` (app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:1067-1068), a Relation that is never nil, so validate_event's `trade.void?` (trade_controller_helper.rb:2216) runs on a Relation — NoMethodError/500 suspected.
rationale: The nil guard is defeated by a fallback query that returns a Relation.

title: The schema of a non-existent event is refused cleanly
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). None.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 4 'Request not found' from validate_event (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:2215), called by Api::V1::TradeController#event_schema (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:265-277).
rationale: Contrast case for the /trade/:id crash — same helper, no Relation fallback, correct result.

title: An uninvited vendor cannot read a restricted event
preconditions: Session: a vendor that deals with the buyer but is NOT on the restricted audience of {{tradeId}}.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 536 'You are not allowed to view this event.' from validate_event (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:2219-2221); is_allowed_to_view? is false for a restricted audience (app/models/model_helpers/trade_request_model_helper.rb:366-369).
rationale: Specs, quantities and sometimes target prices are competitor-sensitive.

title: A vendor cannot read an unpublished (draft) stage
preconditions: Session: a vendor already added to the audience of a DRAFT stage {{tradeId}}.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 536 'You are not allowed to view this event.' — is_allowed_to_view? denies drafts vendor-side (app/models/model_helpers/trade_request_model_helper.rb:352-353).
rationale: Buyers add audiences while drafting; unfinished prices and quantities must stay invisible until publish.

title: A vendor cannot read the schema of a draft stage
preconditions: Session: vendor on the audience of a DRAFT stage {{tradeId}}.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 536 'You are not allowed to view this event.' via event_schema → validate_event (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:2219-2221).
rationale: The schema carries widget configuration incl. required fields and price validations.

title: A cancelled stage reads as not found
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{tradeId}} was cancelled or voided by the buyer.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 4 'Request not found' from validate_event (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:2216-2217).
rationale: Vendors keep links in email; a cancelled event must read as gone.

title: Hostile layer_ids on the schema read do not crash
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live stage.
steps: 1. GET /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/schema with layer_ids containing a script tag and a quote fragment.
expectedResult: 200 or typed 4xx. layer_ids is read raw in event_schema (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:264).
rationale: Query-string ids feed layer filtering unvalidated.

title: Two teammates of the same vendor see the same participation answer
preconditions: Session: a SECOND user of vendor company {{vendorUuid}}, after the first user answered trade_accept.
expectedResult: Both reads should agree. /trade/:id uses Current.workspace.user_intents (app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:1095); /v1/trade/:id/schema uses Current.user.user_intents (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:287) — the teammate gets true from one and false from the other.
rationale: Company-level vs user-level lookup of the same flag; the second teammate is asked to participate again.

title: Starting a technical response without the stage id is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live technical stage {{rfpTradeId}}.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' from TemplateResponsesController#create app/controllers/api/template_responses_controller.rb:16-17.
rationale: The start call returns the id the answer and submit calls hang off; a missing stage must be refused.

title: Starting a response on an unsupported item type is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live technical stage.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' from the else branch app/controllers/api/template_responses_controller.rb:50-51.
rationale: Only TradeRequest and Proposal are supported; anything else must fall to 101.

title: A technical response cannot be started on an RFQ (commercial) stage
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{tradeId}} here is the sandbox RFQ/pricing stage (rfx_mode rfq).
steps: 1. POST /template_responses with item_uuid of the RFQ stage.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 33 'Order not active' — create restricts the lookup to rfi/rfp (app/controllers/api/template_responses_controller.rb:23), so the set is empty and validate_params_for_trade_request returns 33 (app/controllers/concerns/template_responses_controller_helper.rb:132-133).
rationale: A technical answer on a pricing stage would never be evaluated; the misleading 'Order not active' message is worth pinning.

title: A technical response cannot be started before the stage opens
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{rfpTradeId}} is an Upcoming (published, not yet started) technical stage.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 33 'Order not active' — currently_running_in_bidding_time (app/models/trade_request.rb:222-226) excludes it; app/controllers/concerns/template_responses_controller_helper.rb:132-133.
rationale: Same fairness rule as bidding: no head start on the technical stage.

title: A technical response cannot be started after the stage closed
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{rfpTradeId}} technical stage bid_end_time has passed.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 33 'Order not active' from app/controllers/concerns/template_responses_controller_helper.rb:132-133.
rationale: Late technical responses change who qualifies for the commercial stage after evaluation began.

title: The buyer cannot answer their own technical stage as a participant
preconditions: Session: the BUYER who owns the sandbox event (this is how the platform runner authenticates). Live technical stage; company_uuid set to the buyer's own company.
steps: 1. POST /template_responses with company_uuid = the event's own company.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' from app/controllers/concerns/template_responses_controller_helper.rb:135 (company_id == trade company). Uses the buyer's own company id.
rationale: A buyer-company response on its own event pollutes evaluation and could be awarded.

title: A vendor cannot start a technical response in another vendor's name
preconditions: Session: vendor A. {{vendorUuid}} is a DIFFERENT invited vendor B.
steps: 1. As vendor A, POST /template_responses with company_uuid of vendor B.
expectedResult: Should be refused. validate_params_for_trade_request (app/controllers/concerns/template_responses_controller_helper.rb:108-140) never checks company_id belongs to the caller (unlike bids, which call can_place_bid_for_company). Today a draft owned by A for company B is the suspected outcome.
rationale: Cross-vendor write: A can seed B's technical response and, since the reason strings are shown to the buyer, tamper with B's qualification.

title: Saving answers with no form id is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A technical response {{templateResponseUuid}} has been started.
expectedResult: Should be a typed 4xx. create_form_page_responses (app/controllers/api/template_responses_controller.rb:69-95) reads params['page_ids'] and page_responses; a blank/absent form leaves nothing to persist. Must not 5xx.
rationale: The answer call is keyed by form and page uuids; a missing form must not become a crash.
notRunnable: needs the vendor's technical form/page uuids, which the case runner reads from the technical-stage payload and does not thread through placeholders; documented as a workflow negative and reported not-run.

title: An answer with a key_attribute that is not on the form is ignored, not crashing
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Technical response {{templateResponseUuid}} started; {{techPageUuid}} is its line-item page.
steps: 1. PUT create_page_responses with page_responses whose key_attribute is 'NOT_A_WIDGET_{{stamp}}'.
expectedResult: 200 or typed 4xx. create_draft_form_response iterates form_key_attributes and only stores keys present in the header set (app/helpers/api/forms_helper.rb:343-368); an unknown key falls through get_key_attribute_vs_response_data (app/helpers/api/forms_helper.rb:452-457) and is dropped.
rationale: A wrong key_attribute is the single most common malformed-answer case; it must be dropped, not saved or crashed.
notRunnable: needs the vendor's technical form/page uuids, which the case runner reads from the technical-stage payload and does not thread through placeholders; documented as a workflow negative and reported not-run.

title: An attachment answer sent as an object instead of a list does not crash
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Technical response {{templateResponseUuid}} started.
steps: 1. PUT create_page_responses with an attachment widget value set to {url:...} (an object, not a list).
expectedResult: validate_form_pages_responses_data (app/helpers/api/forms_helper.rb:299-312) raises StandardError 'Invalid Attachments Data' for a non-array, non-string attachment value; that surfaces as a handled error, not a 500 (this widget may be a string field, so no-5xx is the honest assertion).
rationale: Attachment shape confusion is a known raise site inside a transaction; it must stay a typed error.
notRunnable: needs the vendor's technical form/page uuids, which the case runner reads from the technical-stage payload and does not thread through placeholders; documented as a workflow negative and reported not-run.

title: Submitting a technical response with a required answer blank is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A technical response {{templateResponseUuid}} with a required widget left blank.
steps: 1. Save the page with the required field empty.
expectedResult: Should be 422 error.code 572 "Please fill '<field>'" from ValidateService#validate_header (app/services/template_responses/validate_service.rb:158-162), reached via revise_for_item_type → revise_template_response_helper (app/controllers/concerns/template_responses_controller_helper.rb:23). The generic submit body cannot force a specific field blank in one run, so no-5xx is the runnable assertion.
rationale: Required technical answers gate qualification; a blank required field must block submission.

title: A different user cannot submit another user's draft response without edit access
preconditions: Session: a vendor user who did NOT create response {{templateResponseUuid}} and has no editor access-list entry.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 2 (draft not found for company) or 101 (not an editor). update (app/controllers/api/template_responses_controller.rb:55-67) scopes to company_id, and unauthorized_template_response_editor? (app/controllers/api/template_responses_controller.rb:402-410) denies non-owners without editor access.
rationale: The technical response is competitor-sensitive; only its owner or a shared editor may submit it.

title: Answers cannot be saved on a stage that is not running
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A response {{templateResponseUuid}} exists on a technical stage that has since closed.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 33 'Order not active' — for a vendor (not the buyer's company) create_form_page_responses checks item.is_running (app/controllers/api/template_responses_controller.rb:78-82). Requires a closed stage; no-5xx if the sandbox stage is still live.
rationale: A late technical answer edits a response after the window; the window guard must fire.
notRunnable: needs the vendor's technical form/page uuids, which the case runner reads from the technical-stage payload and does not thread through placeholders; documented as a workflow negative and reported not-run.

title: Submitting the same technical response twice does not create a second active response
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Response {{templateResponseUuid}} already submitted (active).
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 2: update (app/controllers/api/template_responses_controller.rb:59) fetches TemplateResponse.draft, which is empty once the response is active, so a re-submit refuses cleanly. No second active row either way.
rationale: Vendors retry submit on flaky networks; a second active response would double-count in evaluation.

title: Saving answers against a non-existent response is refused cleanly
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). None.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 888 'Invalid Parameters' from fetch_template_response (app/controllers/concerns/template_responses_controller_helper.rb:61-62). Must not 5xx.
rationale: A stale or guessed response id must produce a typed error, not a crash.

title: Submitting a non-existent response is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). None.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — update (app/controllers/api/template_responses_controller.rb:59-60) finds no draft response for that id/company.
rationale: Guessed response ids must not submit anything.

title: Opening a bid without a company is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live RFQ stage {{tradeId}}, vendor invited.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' from app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:15-16 (company_id blank).
rationale: company_id names who the bid is for; blank must be refused before any row.

title: Opening a bid without a trade id is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Vendor invited.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — trade_request is nil at app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:14-16.
rationale: No stage means no event to bid on; the presence guard must fire.

title: Opening a bid on a non-existent event is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). None.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — find_by_id returns nil, blank check at app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:14-16.
rationale: A guessed stage id must not open a bid.

title: An uninvited vendor cannot open a bid
preconditions: Session: a vendor NOT on the audience of {{tradeId}}.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 782 'Bid could not be placed. Please refresh and try again.' from app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:20 (allowed_to_bid? false — company not in audience_ids, app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:17-31).
rationale: The core fairness rule: only invited vendors may bid.

title: The buyer cannot open an ordinary bid on their own event
preconditions: Session: the BUYER who owns the sandbox event (this is how the platform runner authenticates). Live RFQ stage; company_uuid set to the buyer's own company.
steps: 1. POST /v1/bids with company_uuid = the event's own company.
expectedResult: Should be refused. is_surrogate_bidding_and_is_allowed? treats the owner as a surrogate bidder (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:2130-2141); a plain self-bid should not create a vendor bid. Uses the buyer's own company id.
rationale: A buyer self-bid would seed a competing quote on their own event.

title: A bid on a superseded event version is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{tradeId}} belongs to an event group that has been amended (a newer version exists).
steps: 1. POST /v1/bids on the old version's stage.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' from app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:18 (event_group.latest? false). Requires an amended event; on a fresh sandbox this stays a clean 4xx.
rationale: Bidding on a stale version writes to an event nobody is running.

title: A bid cannot be opened before the window opens
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{tradeId}} is an Upcoming (published, not started) RFQ stage.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 33 'Order not active' from is_allowed_to_create_bid (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:71-73, !is_running).
rationale: Bidding early breaks fairness — the single most important window rule.

title: A bid cannot be opened after the window closes
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{tradeId}} RFQ stage bid_end_time has passed.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 33 'Order not active' from app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:71-73 (is_running false once bid_end_time passed; is_running at app/models/trade_request.rb:1191-1194).
rationale: A late bid changes the result after the event closed.

title: A bid cannot be opened on an unpublished (draft) stage
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A DRAFT RFQ stage {{tradeId}} with the vendor pre-added to the audience.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 33 'Order not active' — a draft has no running schedule, so is_running is false (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:71-73). A draft is also unviewable to the vendor (is_allowed_to_view? app/models/model_helpers/trade_request_model_helper.rb:352).
rationale: Bidding on an unpublished stage writes into an event the buyer is still editing.

title: Two concurrent create calls do not both succeed
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Live RFQ stage; two create calls fire within 3 seconds for the same (trade, company).
expectedResult: The second call should get 422 code 516 'Transaction in Progress' from lock_transaction (app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:168-174; Rails.cache 3s lock keyed t<id>_c<company>).
rationale: The submit/create pair is the most retried write; the cache lock prevents a double bid.

title: A second bid after one is already active is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). The vendor already has an active bid on {{tradeId}} and lock_quote_after_submission is ON.
steps: 1. POST /v1/bids again for the same company.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 875 'Revise bid is locked. You cannot edit your quote after submission.' from is_allowed_to_create_bid (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:74-76) when lock_quote_after_submission? is set. gate: lock_quote_after_submission
rationale: Config-dependent: with the lock on, one submitted quote is final.

title: A vendor who revoked cannot open a new bid
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). The vendor's previous bid on {{tradeId}} is in revoke status.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 370 'You cannot place a bid after revoking the previous one' from app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:54-56.
rationale: Revocation is meant to be final for that vendor.

title: An unsupported currency code is refused on a multi-currency event
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{tradeId}} has a currency_configuration; the vendor sends an out-of-list code.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 15 'Operation failed' 'Please choose a valid currency' from validate_currency_preference (app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:28, app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:191-192). gate: currency_configuration — no-5xx if the sandbox is single-currency.
rationale: Currency drives every price comparison; an invalid code must be rejected.

title: A vendor who skipped the technical stage cannot open the commercial bid
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). The event has a live/closed RFP technical stage the vendor never responded to; {{tradeId}} is the commercial stage.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 737 'You cannot quote for this item because you didn't participate in the technical stage' — is_allowed_to_create_bid checks template responses (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:30-37) → check_participation_in_technical_and_commercial_stage (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:313-320). gate: a technical (RFP) stage exists.
rationale: Two-stage events require technical qualification before commercial bidding.

title: A negative price is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}} on the live RFQ stage.
steps: 1. POST /v1/bids/{{bidUuid}}/create_bid_products with a trade_products entry priced -5.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 106 'Please enter a valid price' from filter_invalid_params (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:539-546) — note this guard lives on the legacy Api::BidsController path; the v1 create_bid_trade_products path stores price as a float and relies on floor/ceil, so a negative here may instead pass to validate_bid_product_details.
rationale: Negative prices are the canonical bad input; whichever path runs, they must not become a valid quote.

title: A zero price is not added as a quote
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}} on the live RFQ stage.
steps: 1. POST create_bid_products with price 0 in the inline sheet.
expectedResult: allowed_to_add (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5839-5851) only adds a row when price > 0, so a zero-priced row is dropped and create_bid_trade_product_helper sees blank products → 732 'Invalid Input' (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:151-156).
rationale: A zero price is a common 'no quote' signal; it must not create a zero-value bid.

title: A non-numeric price does not crash
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}}.
expectedResult: 200 or typed 4xx. get_line_item_object coerces with &.to_f (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5639) so 'abc' becomes 0.0 and is dropped by allowed_to_add (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5841); must not 5xx.
rationale: String-where-number is a classic fuzz input on the money field.

title: An enormous price is handled without overflow
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}} on an event with no ceiling price.
expectedResult: 200 or a ceiling refusal (38). price is a float column (db/schema.rb bid_trade_products); with no ceil_price the value is stored (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:1145). Must not 5xx or overflow.
rationale: Unbounded price with no ceiling is an integrity risk in the savings/total math.

title: A price above the configured ceiling is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}} on a stage whose line item has a ceiling (max) price.
steps: 1. POST create_bid_products priced far above the ceiling.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 38 'Price cannot be more than the allowed price' from validate_bid_product_details (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:1840-1846), comparing estimated_price to ceil_price_for_user. gate: ceiling price set — no-5xx otherwise.
rationale: The price cap is a hard business rule; over-ceiling quotes must be blocked.

title: A price below the configured floor is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}} on a stage whose line item has a floor (min) price.
steps: 1. POST create_bid_products priced below the floor.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 41 'Price cannot be less than the allowed price' from the floor branch of validate_bid_product_details (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:1848-1855). gate: floor price set.
rationale: Floor caps stop unrealistically low quotes on forward/sell events.

title: A quantity above the line quantity is refused when over-quantity is off
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}}; is_over_quantity_allowed is OFF; line quantity is 10. gate: `is_over_quantity_allowed` must be off for this case's outcome to hold.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 138 'Quantity cannot be greater than the mentioned quantity.' from validate_bid_product_details (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:1902-1904). gate: is_over_quantity_allowed=false (default is true, so this is config-dependent).
rationale: Over-quantity bids distort awarding when the buyer disallows them.

title: A quantity below the line quantity is refused when under-quantity is off
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}}; is_under_quantity_allowed is OFF; line quantity is 10. gate: `is_under_quantity_allowed` must be off for this case's outcome to hold.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 139 'Quantity cannot be less than the mentioned quantity.' from validate_bid_product_details (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:1906-1908). gate: is_under_quantity_allowed=false.
rationale: Under-quantity bids are disallowed when the buyer needs the full lot.

title: A quantity not equal to the auction quantity is refused when fixed-quantity bidding is on
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}}; allow_fixed_quantity_for_bidding is ON; line quantity is 10. gate: `allow_fixed_quantity_for_bidding` must be on for this case's outcome to hold.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 207 'Bid Quantity should be equal to the Auction Quantity' from validate_bid_product_details (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:1898-1900). gate: allow_fixed_quantity_for_bidding=true.
rationale: Fixed-quantity events require an exact-match quantity.

title: A negative quantity is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}}.
steps: 1. POST create_bid_products (legacy trade_products form) with quantity -3.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 35 'Quantity must be greater than zero' from filter_invalid_params (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:547-549) on the legacy path.
rationale: Negative quantity is another canonical bad input.

title: A negative GST is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}}.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 107 'Please enter valid GST' from filter_invalid_params (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:550-552).
rationale: GST feeds the landed cost; negative GST would understate the total.

title: Pricing with no products is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}}.
steps: 1. POST create_bid_products with an empty inline data map.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 732 'Invalid Input' — create_bid_trade_product_helper (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:151-156) refuses a blank product list unless it is a valid delete.
rationale: A bid with no products is a participation with no offer.

title: Pricing a non-existent bid is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). None.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 32 'Bid not found' — Bid.draft.for_company(...).where(id: bid_id).last is nil (app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:120-121).
rationale: A guessed bid id must not receive prices.

title: A vendor cannot price a bid belonging to another company
preconditions: Session: vendor A. {{bidUuid}} is a draft bid owned by vendor B.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 32 'Bid not found' — the bid lookup is scoped to Current.allowed_companies (app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:119-121), so B's bid is invisible to A. Requires a bid owned by another company.
rationale: Cross-company write into a competitor's bid.

title: Pricing a bid after the window closes is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}} whose stage bid_end_time has passed.
expectedResult: When not running, create_bid_trade_products routes to is_allowed_to_modify_counter_offer (app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:125-127) which returns 33 'Order not active' unless a counter-offer modification is applicable (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:792-793). Requires a closed stage.
rationale: Late pricing edits a bid after the window.

title: A sister company cannot pile a second bid onto the same subsidiary network
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}}; another company in the same subsidiary network already bid on {{tradeId}}.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 96 'A bid has already been placed by your team' from app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:134-135 (is_part_of_subsidiary_network?). gate: subsidiary network configured.
rationale: Subsidiary collusion is blocked so one network cannot occupy two ranks.

title: Submitting with no status does not crash
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A priced draft bid {{bidUuid}}.
expectedResult: 200 or typed 4xx. With no status the bid stays draft (update_bid_helper draft branch app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:453) and no technical-participation gate fires; must not 5xx.
rationale: A missing status must not silently activate the bid or crash.

title: Submitting a bid with no products is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}} created but never priced (no bid_products).
steps: 1. PATCH /v1/bids/{{bidUuid}} to active with the working submit body.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 8 'Model error' 'Please bid on at least one product' from Bid#validate_bid_products (app/models/bid.rb:217-223), which fires for a non-fast, non-buyer-added bid activated from draft. surfaces via error_code 15 in the helper.
rationale: A submitted bid with no products is a participation with no offer — the model's own guard.

title: Submitting the same bid twice does not create a second active bid
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A bid {{bidUuid}} already submitted (active).
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 34 'A bid has already been placed from your team' — update refuses when bid.active? and status in [active,draft] (app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:45-47).
rationale: Vendors retry submit; a second active bid would double-rank the same company.

title: A bid cannot be submitted after the window closes
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A priced draft bid {{bidUuid}} whose stage bid_end_time has passed.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 33 'Order not active' — update_bid_action_helper_v1 returns 33 when !is_running and not a counter-offer/justification (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:562-571). Requires a closed stage.
rationale: A late submit changes the result after the event closed.

title: A locked event refuses a second submitted quote
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). lock_quote_after_submission is ON; the vendor already has an active bid; {{bidUuid}} is a new draft. gate: `lock_quote_after_submission` must be on for this case's outcome to hold.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 875 'Revise bid is locked. You cannot edit your quote after submission.' from update_bid_helper (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:385-387). gate: lock_quote_after_submission=true.
rationale: With the lock on, the first submitted quote is final.

title: Submitting a commercial bid that skips technically-qualified lines is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). Two-stage event; the vendor participated technically but priced only some non-regretted lines; {{bidUuid}} is the commercial draft.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 748 'Please enter bid for all line items that are not regretted in technical stage.' — valid_bid_wrt_technical_stage? (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:389, 985-1014) requires every non-regretted, non-TNA technical line to be priced. gate: a technical (RFP) stage exists.
rationale: A partial commercial bid must not leave qualified lines unpriced.

title: A regretted line item cannot then receive a commercial price
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). The vendor marked a line item as regretted; {{bidUuid}} carries a price on that same line.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 800 'You have regretted this line item. Reset your draft bid to continue.' from check_for_regretted_items (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:747, 885-894), or 736 during product creation (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:300-301). gate: line marked regretted first.
rationale: Regretting a line then bidding on it commercially is contradictory; the guard exists for exactly this.

title: A vendor cannot submit another company's bid
preconditions: Session: vendor A. {{bidUuid}} is a draft bid owned by vendor B.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 32 'Bid not found' — Bid.not_in_active.for_company(Current.allowed_companies) excludes B's bid (app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:42-44). Requires a bid owned by another company.
rationale: Cross-company submit would let A finalize B's quote.

title: Submitting a non-existent bid is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). None.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 32 'Bid not found' from app/controllers/api/v1/bids_controller.rb:43-44.
rationale: A guessed bid id must not be submittable.

title: A non-numeric gross_total does not crash
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A priced draft bid {{bidUuid}}.
expectedResult: 200 or typed 4xx. gross_total flows into other_details (app/helpers/api/v1/bids_controller_helper.rb:420); it is display data, not the ranking price. Must not 5xx.
rationale: gross_total is echoed in the orders sheet view — a stored-XSS/type sink.

title: Increasing the price is refused when price increase is not allowed
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A submitted bid {{bidUuid}} on an event with is_price_increase_allowed=false. gate: `is_price_increase_allowed` must be off for this case's outcome to hold.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 300 'You cannot increase the price' — get_approval_type (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:2385-2386) and revise_bid_helper (app/helpers/api/bids_helper.rb:6-7) return 300 when the revised value exceeds the current and increase is disallowed. gate: is_price_increase_allowed=false.
rationale: In a reverse auction prices should only fall; the direction rule enforces it.

title: Decreasing the price is refused when price decrease is not allowed
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A submitted bid {{bidUuid}} on a forward/sell event with is_price_decrease_allowed=false. gate: `is_price_decrease_allowed` must be off for this case's outcome to hold.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 301 'You cannot decrease the price' — get_approval_type (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:2380-2381) / revise_bid_helper (app/helpers/api/bids_helper.rb:9-10). gate: is_price_decrease_allowed=false (forward/sell event).
rationale: In a forward auction prices should only rise; the mirror of the increase rule.

title: A revision smaller than the tick size is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A submitted bid {{bidUuid}} on a line item with a tick size; the new price is within one tick.
steps: 1. PATCH /api/bids/revise_bid/{{bidUuid}} changing the price by less than the tick size.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 214 'Quoted price difference must be greater than the tick size' from validate_bid_product_details (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:1869-1891), which fires only when the non-zero difference is below the tick. gate: tick size configured.
rationale: Tick size stops micro-undercutting in auctions.

title: A bid cannot be revised after the window closes
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A submitted bid {{bidUuid}} on a stage whose bid_end_time has passed (no counter-offer open).
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 33 'Order not active' — update_bid_action_helper (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:67-77) returns 33 when !is_running and no counter-offer modification/justification applies. Requires a closed stage.
rationale: Late revision changes the result after close.

title: A locked event refuses any revision after submission
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). lock_quote_after_submission is ON; {{bidUuid}} is an active submitted bid. gate: `lock_quote_after_submission` must be on for this case's outcome to hold.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 875 'Revise bid is locked. You cannot edit your quote after submission.' from update_bid_action_helper (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:48-50). gate: lock_quote_after_submission=true.
rationale: With the lock on, a submitted quote cannot be revised at all.

title: Revising a non-existent bid is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). None.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 32 'Bid not found' — update_bid finds no bid outside revised/rejected/selected/revoke/in_active/draft (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:110-111).
rationale: A guessed bid id must not be revisable.

title: A bid already selected for award cannot be revised
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{bidUuid}} is a bid the buyer has selected.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 32 'Bid not found' — update_bid excludes selected bids from the lookup (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:110-111). Requires a selected bid.
rationale: A selected bid is committed; revising it would rewrite the award basis.

title: A surrogate technical response with no stage id is refused
preconditions: Session: the BUYER who owns the sandbox event (this is how the platform runner authenticates). Live technical stage; surrogate answer for vendor {{vendorUuid}}.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' from create_surrogate_response app/controllers/api/template_responses_controller.rb:226-227.
rationale: Presence guard on the surrogate entry point.

title: Surrogate bidding disabled by the company is refused
preconditions: Session: the BUYER who owns the sandbox event (this is how the platform runner authenticates). is_buyer_not_allowed_to_add_surrogate_bid is set on {{tradeId}}. gate: `is_buyer_not_allowed_to_add_surrogate_bid` must be on for this case's outcome to hold.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 10 'You are not allowed to use this functionality' — is_surrogate_bidding_and_is_allowed? (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:2134-2135) via create_surrogate_trade_request_response (app/controllers/concerns/template_responses_controller_helper.rb:266-267). gate: is_buyer_not_allowed_to_add_surrogate_bid=true.
rationale: Some companies forbid buyers entering bids for vendors; the config must be honoured.
notRunnable: needs the vendor's technical form/page uuids, which the case runner reads from the technical-stage payload and does not thread through placeholders; documented as a workflow negative and reported not-run.

title: A user without surrogate rights cannot enter a vendor's technical response
preconditions: Session: a member who is not the event owner, not a valid team member and not a super_admin, on {{tradeId}}.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 165 'Cannot place bid on trade by your own company' — is_valid_surrogate_bidder requires super_admin or valid team or owner (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:2136-2138).
rationale: Surrogate entry is a powerful buyer action; only authorised users may do it.
notRunnable: needs the vendor's technical form/page uuids, which the case runner reads from the technical-stage payload and does not thread through placeholders; documented as a workflow negative and reported not-run.

title: A surrogate technical response is refused after the window unless post-expiry surrogates are on
preconditions: Session: the BUYER who owns the sandbox event (this is how the platform runner authenticates). {{tradeId}} technical stage has closed and is_allowed_to_add_surrogate_bid_post_expiry is off. gate: `is_allowed_to_add_surrogate_bid_post_expiry` must be off for this case's outcome to hold.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 33 'Order not active' — create_surrogate_trade_request_response (app/controllers/concerns/template_responses_controller_helper.rb:265) requires is_upcoming_or_running or the post-expiry flag. gate: is_allowed_to_add_surrogate_bid_post_expiry=false + closed stage.
rationale: Post-close surrogate entry is only allowed when the buyer explicitly enabled it.
notRunnable: needs the vendor's technical form/page uuids, which the case runner reads from the technical-stage payload and does not thread through placeholders; documented as a workflow negative and reported not-run.

title: A surrogate response after the vendor already responded is refused unless allowed-after-bid is on
preconditions: Session: the BUYER who owns the sandbox event (this is how the platform runner authenticates). Vendor {{vendorUuid}} already has an active technical response on {{tradeId}}; allowed_surrogate_bid_even_after_bid is off. gate: `allowed_surrogate_bid_even_after_bid` must be off for this case's outcome to hold.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 30 'Bid already placed for this order' — create_surrogate_trade_request_response (app/controllers/concerns/template_responses_controller_helper.rb:268-272) blocks a second response unless allowed_surrogate_bid_even_after_bid. gate: allowed_surrogate_bid_even_after_bid=false.
rationale: The buyer must not overwrite a vendor's own submitted response by default.
notRunnable: needs the vendor's technical form/page uuids, which the case runner reads from the technical-stage payload and does not thread through placeholders; documented as a workflow negative and reported not-run.

title: A surrogate RFQ bid disabled by the company is refused
preconditions: Session: the BUYER who owns the sandbox event (this is how the platform runner authenticates). is_buyer_not_allowed_to_add_surrogate_bid is set on the RFQ stage {{tradeId}}. gate: `is_buyer_not_allowed_to_add_surrogate_bid` must be on for this case's outcome to hold.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 10 'You are not allowed to use this functionality' — create_bid → allowed_surrogate_bid_placement (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:47) → is_surrogate_bidding_and_is_allowed? (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:2134-2135). gate: is_buyer_not_allowed_to_add_surrogate_bid=true.
rationale: The config that forbids surrogate bidding must apply to the commercial path too.

title: A surrogate bid after the vendor already bid is refused unless allowed-after-bid is on
preconditions: Session: the BUYER who owns the sandbox event (this is how the platform runner authenticates). Vendor {{vendorUuid}} already has an active bid on {{tradeId}}; allowed_surrogate_bid_even_after_bid is off. gate: `allowed_surrogate_bid_even_after_bid` must be off for this case's outcome to hold.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 99 'A bid is already placed on behalf of this company.' — validate_existing_bids_if_present (app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:2760-2764). gate: allowed_surrogate_bid_even_after_bid=false.
rationale: The buyer must not clobber a vendor's own bid; the flag governs re-entry.

title: A surrogate RFQ bid before the window is refused unless surrogate is allowed
preconditions: Session: the BUYER who owns the sandbox event (this is how the platform runner authenticates). {{tradeId}} is an Upcoming RFQ stage.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 33 'Order not active' — create_bid requires is_running, or (surrogate AND upcoming_or_running/post-expiry) (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:50). An upcoming surrogate is allowed only via is_upcoming_or_running, so a not-yet-published stage refuses.
rationale: Timing rules apply to surrogate bids too.

title: A non-surrogate call on a staggered event is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{tradeId}} is a staggered (serial) auction and the caller is not surrogate.
steps: 1. POST /v1/bids on the staggered stage as the vendor.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 508 'Not allowed to bid on this product' — allowed_surrogate_bid_placement (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:426-427) blocks non-surrogate bids on staggered events via this API. gate: staggered/serial auction.
rationale: Serial bidding has its own path; ordinary create must be refused.

title: A surrogate RFQ bid with no company is refused
preconditions: Session: the BUYER who owns the sandbox event (this is how the platform runner authenticates). Live RFQ stage.
expectedResult: Should be a typed 4xx. create_bid reads company_id (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:35); a blank company means can_place_bid_for_company fails (101) or the transform finds no data. Must not 5xx.
rationale: The surrogate call still needs to name the vendor it bids for.

title: An unknown regret action type is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}} and line item {{lineItemUuid}} on {{tradeId}}.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 805 'Invalid action type' from LineItemRegretService#validate (app/services/bids/line_item_regret_service.rb:96, ACTION_TYPES = regret/undo_regret). This route is not on the platform allowlist, so it is reported not-run.
rationale: Only regret/undo_regret are valid; anything else must be refused.

title: Regretting a line on a non-existent bid is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). None.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 806 'Bid not found' from LineItemRegretService#validate (app/services/bids/line_item_regret_service.rb:97). Not on the platform allowlist — reported not-run.
rationale: A guessed bid id must not accept a regret.

title: Regretting with a trade id that is not this bid's trade is refused
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A draft bid {{bidUuid}}; the trade id passed belongs to a different stage.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 95 'Trade Request not found' — validate returns 95 when trade_request nil or trade_request.id != bid.trade_request_id (app/services/bids/line_item_regret_service.rb:100, 102). Not on the platform allowlist — reported not-run.
rationale: A regret must apply to the bid's own stage, not an arbitrary one.

title: A vendor cannot regret every line item in a lot-split event
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). A lot-split event where regretting {{lineItemUuid}} would leave no active lines for the vendor.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 844 'You cannot regret all line items in a lot split event' — restrict_lot_event_full_egli_prunning (app/services/bids/line_item_regret_service.rb:115-128). gate: lot-split event. Not on the platform allowlist — reported not-run.
rationale: Regretting the whole lot would leave the vendor participating in nothing.

title: During cost-breakdown time, global price updates are ignored
preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{tradeId}} is in cost-breakdown (CBD) review time; {{bidUuid}} is the vendor's bid.
steps: 1. PATCH /v1/bids/{{bidUuid}} with a changed gross_total while CBD is running.
expectedResult: During CBD, parse_components_for_bid drops all but price/serial_number and clears global updates (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:6658-6661). The global gross_total change should not alter the ranking price. gate: in_cost_break_down_time.
rationale: CBD is a cost-justification phase, not a re-quote; global changes must not move the rank.

title: With mandatory T&C on, every clause is treated as required
